name: Duelist Circle 2.0 - unfair-card banlist (group vote result 2026-10-30)
status: APPROVED - the group vote is closed and its result was applied on 2026-10-30 (data/cardpool/vote-results-2026-10-30.json, docs/CARD_VOTE_RESULT_2026-10-30.md). Entries the vote changed keep the old reason in proposal_reason and the votes in group_vote_2026_10_30; a card the vote moved to 3 per deck is listed under removed_by_group_vote (not read by the scripts).
concept: Strong cards are fine; unfair cards are not. OUT: lock/stall cards, floodgates, one-turn-kill combo engines and burn loops, Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End. ALLOWED: alternate win conditions (Exodia, Final Countdown, Destiny Board, Vennominaga...). One-sided / mass board wipes become Legendary (1 copy in the whole league).

verdicts.limited_1_per_deck: Max 1 copy per deck (each player may own/play one).
verdicts.legendary_unique: Legendary rarity: only 1 copy exists in the whole league (and max 1 per deck).

precedence_note: A verdict here overrides the October 2014 TCG list for that card (e.g. Harpie's Feather Duster: era-forbidden -> legendary_unique, per owner). Cards not listed here keep their October 2014 TCG status.
method: Known historical lock/FTK/burn-loop cards + text heuristics over the YGOPRODeck snapshot restricted to the Classic pool (neither player can / your opponent cannot / skip / cannot declare an attack / destroy all ... / repeated inflict-damage) + judgment against the CURRENT (errata'd) card text used by Master Duel. Example: Catapult Turtle is NOT listed because its current text is once per turn, so it no longer loops.
not_listed_on_purpose: Jinzo - Boss Route boss card (Jinzo route), a monster-body floodgate that dies to battle/removal.
Necrovalley / Hidden Temples of Necrovalley - Gravekeeper archetype core; strong, not a full lock.
Thunder King Rai-Oh, Dimensional Fissure, Macro Cosmos - already Limited on the 2014 list; that is enough.
Exodia pieces, Final Countdown, Destiny Board, Vennominaga - alternate win conditions are allowed (2014 Limited status of Exodia pieces / Final Countdown kept as-is).
Catapult Turtle - errata'd to once per turn in current text.
Power Bond / Limiter Removal OTKs - strong, not unfair; Limiter Removal stays Limited (2014).
